Aneta Laboutková (born 10 May 2000) is a Czech tennis player. Laboutková has a career-high singles ranking by the WTA of 445, achieved on 19 December 2022, and a best doubles ranking of world No. 169, achieved on 20 October 2025. [ 1 ] Laboutková has a career-high ITF juniors ranking of No. 595, achieved on 14 March 2016. [ 2 ] Career [ edit ] Laboutková won her first W75 title at the 2024 Ismaning Open in the doubles draw, partnering with Aneta Kučmová .
